name: Wan 2.2 — 5B Image to Video
description: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B (fp16, Apache 2.0): animates an approved still into a ~5 s silent clip at 720p/24 fps. The lightest video engine — fits 8 GB-class cards with ComfyUI's native offloading. 20-step uni_pc sampling; no audio is generated.

prompt_guide.style: Wan 2.2 animates a provided still, so the prompt describes motion only — never re-describe what the frame already shows, and never mention sound (the model generates silent clips). One short present-tense paragraph in plain sentences: how the subject moves, how the camera moves (push in, pan, orbit, hold), and how the environment lives — wind, rain, steam, drifting smoke, flickering light. Modest, physically plausible motion reads best; one clear camera move beats several.
examples: She sets the cup down and turns toward the window, hair shifting as she moves. The camera pushes in slowly from a medium shot while rain streaks the glass and the curtain sways in a faint draft.

The fisherman hauls the rope hand over hand, shoulders working, as the deck tilts gently with the swell. The camera holds steady; spray drifts through the frame and gulls wheel across the gray sky behind him.
